Name: Luck
Components: V, S, M (a four-leaf clover or rabbit’s foot)
Description:
You touch a willing creature and imbue them with good fortune. For the duration, the target gains 2 Luck points, which last for the duration. When the recipient makes an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, they can spend a Luck point to gain advantage on the roll. They can also use their reaction to expend a Luck point to reroll a number of damage dice for a spell or weapon attack up to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of 1), and accept either result.

Once the target spends a Luck point, they cannot spend another until the start of their next turn.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the target gains 1 additional Luck point for each slot level above 3rd.
